userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Customer paid or is entitled to exit but the gate did not open.
The customer's payment was declined or failed at the lane/pay station.
An expected validation/discount is not applied to the session.
The amount due does not match the expected rate calculation.
The customer cannot present the entry ticket.
A credential was denied because of anti-passback state.
A monthly/account holder was denied because of an outstanding balance or account status.
A prepaid reservation exists but is not linked to the current session (wrong or unread plate, unscanned code).
The session has no plate or a low-confidence/incorrect plate association.
A lane device (payment terminal, ticket reader, gate, intercom, camera) is offline or faulted.
The issue could not be classified from available signals.
The help button was pressed or the number dialled, but nobody answered the agent.
The contact ended before the issue was stated or resolved.
The agent cannot hear the parker or the parker cannot hear the agent; a fault in the lane's call equipment.
A question about rates, hours, directions or the facility, with no transaction problem.
The parker is at the wrong garage, dialled the wrong number, or the vehicle does not fit.
No space is available for the arriving vehicle.
The entry ticket is present but the device cannot read it (damaged, demagnetized, faded).
The device refuses or will not return a readable ticket, including a ticket stuck on cancel.
The entry station issued no ticket, typically because it is out of tickets (see DeviceStatus.consumables).
The ticket is paid, but the exit does not open; a payment-status lookup is the first step.
The card reader does not read the payment card at all, as distinct from a decline.
The parker cannot pay with what they have (card-only device, no money, needs change).
A ticket, bill or card is jammed or stuck in the device.
The barrier is stuck open and vehicles pass without a transaction.
A holder arrived without their card, transponder or fob.
The holder's credential is present but disabled or deactivated.
A dispute about the grace period, for example a fee charged just after it ended.
A validation was applied but has expired, so an amount is due.
A hotel guest, vendor, employee, police officer or security staff needing entry under the place's guest arrangements (resolve with guestReference).
The customer needs a receipt sent or printed again (Part 13 receipt re-send).
The customer asks for a refund or credit (reason from apx-refund-reasons).
A vehicle was damaged, broken into or towed at the place; raises a damageReported alert.
A technician testing the equipment, not a customer; excluded from service figures.
